name: Studio Zero
description: Welcome to STUDIO ZERO, RVCE's filmmaking club! We're a passionate community of movie enthusiasts who bring stories to life through collaborative filmmaking. Whether you're interested in acting, directing, cinematography, editing, music composition, or any other aspect of film production, there's a place for you here.

events.name: From LeNS TO CUt

events.name: Endless Juggle - Don’t Drop It!
events.detail: Think you’ve got balance and focus? Time to prove it! Keep the bat, ball, and football going endlessly—drop it, and you’re out. Simple? Wait till you try it.

events.name: Ask Seniors Anything - NO Filter
events.detail: All Answers Your chance to spill those burning questions—anonymously! From college hacks to untold stories, our seniors are here to answer it all, straight and unfiltered.

events.name: RAAG Presents Open Mic-Your
events.detail: Stage. Your Vibe. The spotlight’s yours—sing, rap, recite, or just grab the mic and vibe. Whether you’re performing or cheering, it’s going to be an evening of raw talent and pure energy.
